Name: Green Manure Alfalfa
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Medicago sativa. Code: VGR10. A hardy perennial normally grown as a short-term (2-3 month) green manure. Adds bulk plus some nitrogen fixation to the soil. Sow between April and July at a rate of 10Kg/acre (2.5 grams per sq. m.). Avoid acidic or waterlogged soils.

Name: Green Manure Blue Lupin
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Lupinus angustifolius. Code: VGR45. Sown from March to June this deep rooting manure provides excellent nitrogen fixation. Most effective on light acidic soils. Sow at 25Kg/acre (6.25 grams per sq. m.). Turn in before flowering.

Name: Green Manure Buckwheat
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Fagopyrum esculentum. Code: VGR12. A rapidly establishing weed supressor that is effective at rejuvenating low fertility soils. Can also attract beneficial insects depending upon stage at turn in. For sowing April-August at 40kg/acre (10 grams/sqm). Height typically 60-80cm. Not frost hardy.

Name: Green Manure Forage Rye
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Secale cereale. Code: VGR25. For August-November sowings at 35Kg/acre (8.75 grams per sq. m.), for turning in early April or May. Suited to most soil types, and copes well with heavier soils.

Name: Green Manure Mustard White
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Sinapis alba. Code: VGR28. A quality Mustard variety that develops a high level of green matter and residual fibre. For sowing early March-September at 18Kg/acre (4.5 grams per sq. m.). Quick growing, to a height of 60-90cm, good standing ability. Turn in before flowering.

Name: Green Manure Mustard, Brown
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Brassica juncea. Code: VGR27. A quickly establishing green manure that can help reduce Potato Cyst Nematodes when turned in. Also good for weed supression. For sowing early March-September at 18kg/acre (4.5 grams/sqm). Height typically 60-90cm. More frost hardy than other mustards.

Name: Green Manure Phacelia Tanacetifolia
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Phacelia tanacetifolia. Code: VGR30. For sowing March-September. Quick-maturing, with dense plant foliage, height up to one metre. Sowing rate 4Kg/acre (1 gram per sq. m.). Turn in prior to flowering.

Name: Green Manure Red Clover
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Trifolium pratense. Code: VGR35. This provides excellent nitrogen fixation performance. Best on good loams. Sow April-August. Sow at 6-8Kg/acre (2 grams per sq. m.).

Name: Green Manure White Clover
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Trifolium repens. Code: VGR38. A blend of broad, small and medium varieties, providing a long growth period and good regeneration rate. Sow April- August. Sow at 2-4Kg/acre (1 gram per sq. m.).

Name: Green Manure Winter Tares
Description: Product Group: Certified. Botanical Name: Vicia sativa. Code: VGR40. Also known as Purple Vetch. A nitrogen-fixing plant for sowing at 22Kg/acre (5.5 grams per sq. m.) March-May or July-September for over-wintering. Not recommended for acidic soils.

Name: Herb Balm, Lemon (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Melissa officinalis. Code: VOG737. (Mellissa officinalis) Perennial: 2,000 seeds per gram. Often called Lemon Balm. Height 40-60cm. Used for medicinal purposes, seasoning and for flavouring fruit cordials.

Name: Herb Borage (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Borago officinalis. Code: VOG750. (Borago officinalis) Annual: 65 seeds per gram. Bushy plant with large bristly hairy leaves. Height 30-50cm. Useful for beekeepers. Used for flavouring cordials. 150 grams for 1,000 9cm pots.

Name: Herb Chamomile (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Matricaria chamomilla. Code: VOG755. (Matricaria chamomilla) Annual: 20,000 seeds per gram. Height 10-40cm. Flowers used in hair rinses and in teas to aid digestion and insomnia.

Name: Herb Marjoram Pot (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Origanum vulgare. Code: VOG795. (Origanum vulgare) Perennial: 7,200 seeds per gram. Erect densely hairy stems, pale pink flowers are borne on oblong heads. Height 40-60cm. 5 grams for 1,000 9cm pots.

Name: Herb Marjoram Sweet (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Origanum majorana. Code: VOG800. (Origanum majorana) Annual: 4,000 seeds per gram. Very popular herb for both seasoning and medicinal purposes. Height 50cm. 5 grams per 1,000 9cm pots.

Name: Kohl Rabi Azur Star (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Brassica oleracea Gongylodes. Code: VOG330. Ideal variety for early greenhouse work and maincrop open field production. Strong purple skin colouring and tender flesh, high slender stalks and attractive leaves. Suitable for heated and cold greenhouse production, with good resistance to bolting.

Name: Kohl Rabi F1 Ballot
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica oleracea Gongylodes. Code: VKO10. An early maturing purple variety with round shaped stems and good quality, delicate flesh. Resistant to bolting, stem splitting and lignification. Maturity time is typically 75-80 days.

Name: Kohl Rabi F1 Kref
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica oleracea Gongylodes. Code: VKO22. A very early light green variety, suitable for both forcing and year round field production. Highly resistant to stem splitting, lignification, bolting and over-enlargement. Globular shape with good qaulity, tender flesh. 75-80 days maturity.

Name: Kohl Rabi Noriko (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Brassica oleracea Gongylodes. Code: VOG342. Pale green skinned variety. Very uniform plants of high quality for May-October harvesting. 250 seeds per gram.

Name: Kohl Rabi Purple Micro
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica oleracea Gongylodes. Code: VKO30. A Kohl Rabi variety produced specifically for microgreen production. The microgreens produced feature a green leaf and purple stem. 300 sds/gram.

Name: Mizuna (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa var. japonica. Code: VOG485. Closely related to Mibuna; pencil thin white stalks with serrated, dark green leaves. A very prolific cropper which will reform after cutting. 350 seeds per gram.

Name: Oriental Mibuna
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica juncea var. japonica. Code: VOR020. Strong, fast growing brassica strap-like leaves, densely packed heads. Mild flavour. 350 seeds per gram.

Name: Oriental Mizuna
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa var. japonica. Code: VOR025. Closely related to Mibuna; pencil thin white stalks with serrated, dark green leaves. A very prolific cropper which will reform after cutting. 350 seeds per gram.

Name: Oriental Mustard Golden Streaks
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica juncea. Code: VOR090. A highly attractive, finely dissected leaf which has a sweet mustard flavour. Good texture for salad packs and processing. 500 seeds per gram.

Name: Oriental Mustard Green Giant

Name: Tomato F1 Crokini
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO122. A sweet (Brix 8.5o) cherry variety with a light acidic taste. Typically 10-12 fruits per truss. Good on-vine performance with no cracking. A recent AAS winner. Fruit: red, cherry, 14-18 grams. Resistant to ToMV (0-2), Pf (A-E), Fol (0), Ma, Mi, Mj, Pi and TYLCV.

Name: Tomato F1 Floridity
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO132. An indeterminate variety that produces attractive mini plum shaped red fruits. Crunchy texture, juicy flesh and sweet flavour (Brix 9.5o). Resistant to cracking. Fruit: red, mini-plum, 15-20 grams. Resistant to Fol (1); intermediate resistance to Ma, Mi, Mj.

Name: Tomato F1 Gallant
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO054. Suitable for both heated and cool production, as well as outdoor use in milder areas. Produces a good yield of round, red, fruits that do not crack or fall prematurely. Up to 12 fruits per truss and can be harvested as whole clusters. Fruit: red, round, 65-85 grams. Resistant to ToMV (1-3), Fol (0&1) and Vd (0).

Name: Tomato F1 Golden Ruby
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO236. Attractive mini plum fruits that mature to an eyecatching orange colour. Sweet flavour (Brix typically around 9o), coupled with tasty flesh. Quick to deliver first trusses. Good storage performance. Fruit: orange, mini-plum, 18-22 grams. Resistant to Fol (2).

Name: Tomato F1 Golden Shine
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO150. A tall variety producing distinctive large, bright orange-yellow round fruits of up to 250 grams in weight. 4-6 fruits per cluster. A distinctive and tasty flavour. Tolerant of cracking. An ideal product for fresh market sales. Fruit: orange, round, 200-250 grams. Resistant to Fol (1)

Name: Tomato F1 Golden Sweet
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO235. Grape shaped fruit with distinctive orange-yellow colour. Good flavour with fine, firm, sweet flesh. Fruit resists cracking. Fruit: orange, grape, 12-16 grams. Tolerant to Pi, Pf (1-5).

Name: Tomato F1 Honey Delight
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO062. A hybrid cocktail variety that produces bright yellow fruits, typically around 40 grams in weight. A regular winner in taste tests due to its excellent sugar-acid balance. Prolific cropper. Fruit: yelolow, cocktail, 35-45 grams. Resistant to Fol (0&1).

Name: Tomato F1 Honeycomb
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO024. An exquisitely flavoured golden-orange tomato. The cherry sized fruit are elegantly arranged on long trusses. Exceptional flavour with a high level of sweetness, with a delightful aftertaste described in trials as being somewhat like honey. Fruit: orange, cherry, 14-16 grams. Resistant to Fol (0,1,2), ToMV, Pi, Pst, Xcv plus some blight resistance.

Name: Tomato F1 Knockout
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO448. This variety produces probably the largest fruit we have ever trialled. The large, red, Beefsteak fruits can typically weigh between 0.9-1.4Kg, depending upon the growing conditions. Bursting with flavour and luscious flesh. Fruit: red, beefsteak, 900-1400 grams. Resistant to Va.

Name: Tomato F1 Merrygold
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO026. A blight resistant orange-fruited variety. Produces a bountiful crop of brightly coloured cherry sized fruits. Sweet and tangy flavoured. Ideally grown under protection this variety also works outdoors in milder areas. Fruit: orange, cherry, 14-16 grams. Resistant to Fol (0,1,2) and Pi.

Name: Tomato F1 Miele
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO025. An indeterminate mini plum variety that produces a prolific crop of intense yellow coloured fruits. A high sugar content gives a very sweet taste, while the flesh has a good texture. Good on-truss fruit presentation. Suitable for loose and on the vine sales. Fruit: yellow, mini plum, 15-20 grams. Resistant to Fol (1&2), Ma, Mi and Mj.

Name: Tomato F1 Modus
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO010. An indeterminate mini plum type, with small oval shaped fruits. Slightly longer than F1 Rosada, with a higher sugar content. Attractive colour. Good storage performance; suitable for loose and on the vine sales. Fruit: orange-red, cherry plum, 14-16 grams. Resistant to Fol (1), Va, Vd.

Name: Tomato F1 Orange Wellington
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO446. Smooth, orange fruit with vibrant colour, while the flesh is firm, dense and nearly seedless. Beefsteak variety with fruit typically 250-350 grams in weight. Awarded an Award of Garden Merit from the Royal Horticultural Society. Fruit: orange, beefsteak, 250-350 grams. Resistant to Va, Fol (0&1).

Name: Tomato F1 Orangeto
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO530. A late blight resistant orange-fruited variety. Produces a sumptuous yield of intensely sweet flavoured fruits, with a typcal Brix of 11.5o. It is not unknown for a single plant to produce 4Kg of fruit. Bushy habit makes it ideal for containers. Also known as Sungold Super Sweet.  Fruit: orange, cocktail, 25-35 grams.

Name: Tomato F1 Pannovy
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO080. A vigorous and well proven variety, suitable for use in soil or in substrate. Very high quality fruit with bright red colour, round shape and excellent flavour. Fruit size is very uniform. Fruit: red, round, 75-85 grams. Resistant to ToMV (0-2), Va, Vd, Fol (1&2) and Pf (1-5).

Name: Tomato F1 Protector (rootstock)
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO615. A generative type rootstock, giving increased fruit production coupled with additional disease resistance. Strong root system. Fruit: N/A. Resistant to ToMV, Fol (1,2,3), Va, Vd, For, Ma, Mi, Mj, Pl.

Name: Tomato F1 Red Profusion
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO525. A very early to mature bush variety that forms a good tidy structure with an excellent branching habit. One plant is capable of filling a 30cm basket. Produces a decent crop of sweet cherry fruits, typically 18-22 grams in weight. Ideal for growing in containers. Works well outside due to good weather tolerance. Fruit: red, cherry, 18-22 grams.

Name: Tomato F1 Santa Victoria
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO128. A mini plum variety with a great flavour. Produces a high yield of bright red coloured fruit on long trusses. Ideal for plant sales but also works well with rootstocks for long season commerical cropping under glass Resistant to cracking. Fruit: red, mini-plum, 14-18 grams. Resistant to ToMV (0,2), Fol (0), Pf (1-5), and intermediate resistance to TYLCV.

Name: Tomato F1 Shirley
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO110. Early, short-jointed type with large trusses giving heavy yields of good-shaped fruits. Good for colder crops. A top seller for young plant sales. Fruit: red, round, 70-90 grams. Resistant to TMV(1&2), Pf(1-5), Va, Vd

Name: Tomato F1 Sparta
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO120. A vigorous plant habit with short internodes. Fruits are slightly flat round and firm. Suitable for both protected and outdoor cropping. Good shipping and storage ability. Fruit: red, flat round, 100-130 grams. Resistant to ToMV, Va, Vd, Fol (0&1), Pf (1-5), Ma, Mi, Mj

Name: Tomato F1 Sungold
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO305. Small, delicious tasting orange coloured fruits on long trusses - ideal for salads. Fruit: orange, cherry, 14-18 grams. Resistant to ToMV, Fol (1)

Name: Tomato F1 Sungrape
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO012. A productive, early maturing, variety with red, baby grape shaped fruits. Thin skins but resistant to splitting. Sweet, sharp flavour. Resistant to ToMV (2), Fol (1), Va, Vd and Mj.

Name: Tomato F1 Sweet Million
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO284. A productive variety that produces a mass of cherry sized fruits. Ideal for cold glasshouse production but can also be used for outdoor container work, such as sunny patios. Popular for plant sales. Excellent flavour. Fruit: red, round, 18-25 grams.

Name: Tomato F1 Terenzo
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO520. A hybrid 'Tumbler' type producing a prolific yield of cherry sized, red, round fruits. Fruits typically weigh 18-20 grams, with a Brix reading of 6oBx. Fruit: red, cherry, 14-18 grams.

Name: Tomato F1 Totem
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO310. A dwarf determinate variety which does not require the removal of side-shoots. An excellent item for young plant sales, as it may be used in pots, tubs, window boxes, gro-bags and in the garden. Fruit: red, round, 60-80 grams.

Name: Tomato F1 Tremolo
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO350. A great flavoured red cherry variety. Vigorous and open habit, with trusses that typically feature 18-20 fruits. Firm fruits; attractive colour. Strong against cracking. Fruit: red, cherry, 14-16 grams. Resistant to ToMV (0-2), ToANV, Pf (1-5), Fol (1&2) and TYLCV.

Name: Tomato F1 Trilly
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO032. A mini San Marzano type that produces a very high yield of sweet, tasty fruits, typically around 20g in weight. Suitable for both cluster and single fruit harvest. Fruit: red, cherry plum, 20-25 grams. Resistant to Fol (0), Va, Vd.

Name: Tomato F1 Tropical Ruby
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO160. A semi-determinate variety producing attractive oval shaped, bright red coloured fruits. High sugar content gives an excellent sweet flavour. Popular for both retail plant and fresh market sales. Fruit: red, oblong, 12-16 grams. Tolerant to Fol (1)

Name: Tomato F1 Tumbler
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO320. A determinate variety producing up to 2kg of fruit per plant. Ideal for use in hanging baskets (one plant per 12” basket). Fruit: red, cherry, 12-16 grams.

Name: Tomato F1 Veranda
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO484. A compact dwarf variety that is ideal for container growing; works well in pots from 11cm to 16cm in diameter. The fruits are cherry sized with an attractive red colour. Sweet flavour. Support only needed when grown on to around 45cm in height. Fruit: red, cherry, 12-16 grams. Resistant to Fol (0,1),Va and Pi.

Name: Tomato Gardener's Delight
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO276. An old variety but still as popular as ever. The numerous small fruits have a fine tangy flavour. We offer the originator's selection. Fruit: red, cherry, 14-18 grams.

Name: Tomato Moneymaker
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO250. Medium size, heavy cropper, very popular for the plant trade. 375 seeds per gram. Fruit: red, round, 70-90 grams.

Name: Tomato Roma Vf
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO360. A highly productive variety with delicious fleshy, plum-shaped fruits. Ideal for sauces and soups - may need some support. 375 seeds per gram. Fruit: red, plum, 50-70 grams.

Name: Tomato Rubinka
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO272. An early maturing variety that produces small, tasty, cherry sized fruits. Trusses are long and branched with up to 35 fruits per truss. Suitable for outdoor and cold protected cropping. Fruits resistant to cracking. Resistant to Fol (0). Approximately 400 seeds per gram. Fruit: red, cherry, 15-20 grams.

Name: Tomato San Marzano
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO390. A determinate version of the popular heritage variety. Produces large plum tomatoes, ideal for classic Italian sauces. 380 seeds per gram. Fruit: red, plum, 90-120 grams.

Name: Tomato Super Marmande
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO270. Large, somewhat uneven fruited variety. Very well flavoured. Strong, vigorous plants, which are popular for retail young plant sales. Fruit: red, beefsteak, 160-180 grams.

Name: Tomato Sweet Aperitif
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO014. A prolific indeterminate variety producing an excellent yield of tasty, bite sized fruits. The fruits have a shiny red colour, thin skins and a sweet flavour. Makes a good subject for plant sales. Suitable for growing under protection and outdoors during the summer months. Fruit: red, cherry plum, 12-16 grams.

Name: Tomato Tumbling Tom Red
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO330. Cascading, highly productive variety for basket and container work. Sweetly flavoured cherry fruits which look very attractive on the plant. Fruit: red, cherry, 12-16 grams.

Name: Tomato Tumbling Tom Yellow
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Solanum lycopersicum. Code: VTO335. Cascading, highly productive variety for basket and container work. Sweetly flavoured cherry fruits which look very attractive on the plant. Fruit: yellow, cherry, 12-16 grams.

Name: Turnip F1 Falko
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa subsp. rapa. Code: VTU60. Round shaped hybrid Milan type, with high uniformity. Excellent internal quality; smooth skin. High heat tolerance. Maturity is around 55 days from sowing. Suitable for early protected cropping and maincrop field production.

Name: Turnip F1 Tokyo Cross
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa subsp. rapa. Code: VTU20. A very quick maturing, pure white, variety. From sowing to harvest is typically 35-60 days depending upon desired harvest size. Roots are a perfect globe shape, with a very smooth texture to the skin and flesh. Can be harvested from 6cm up to 15cm without the risk of going pithy.

Name: Turnip Goldana
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa subsp. rapa. Code: VTU45. An improved version of the popular Golden Ball. A maincrop variety that produces uniform yellow fleshed roots. Tender flesh with good flavour.

Name: Turnip Purple Top Milan
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa subsp. rapa. Code: VTU40. Purple-topped variety with white base below soil level. Very popular for fresh market sales; good quality flattish roots.

Name: Turnip Purple Top Milan (organic)
Description: Product Group: Organic. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa subsp. rapa. Code: VOG730. Purple-topped variety with white base below soil level. Very popular for fresh market sales; good quality flattish roots.

Name: Turnip Snowball
Description: Product Group: Vegetables. Botanical Name: Brassica rapa subsp. rapa. Code: VTU10. An old variety that still has a following, especially with those who use it for exhibitions. White skinned type, early and relatively quick maturing.
